en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programme starts on Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the 2026/27 schemes open on 17 September, offering free or subsidised jabs while influenza activity remains high.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes will begin on Thursday, 17 September. The package covers the school outreach programme, the residential care home vaccination programme and the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme.

The Hospital Authority said public hospitals and outpatient clinics will from the same day vaccinate eligible patients who have follow-up appointments or are admitted, including people aged six months to under 18 and those aged 50 or above, pregnant women, eligible people with disabilities, patients aged 18 to 49 with chronic illnesses, and long-stay in-patients. People aged 18 or above should register with eHealth before receiving a jab.

A CHP official said influenza activity has stayed high since the season began in late June, and that antibodies typically take about two weeks to develop after vaccination. The government has added an electronic consent form on the eHealth mobile app from 17 September for people using private clinics under the subsidy scheme. Parents of eligible children have been able to submit school outreach consent through the same app since 17 August.

zh.headline: 季節性流感疫苗接種計劃周四展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，2026／27年度計劃將於9月17日展開，合資格人士可免費或獲資助接種，本港流感活躍程度仍處高水平。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心表示，二〇二六／二七年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃將於星期四（9月17日）展開，包括學校外展計劃、院舍防疫注射計劃及疫苗資助計劃。
醫院管理局表示，同日起會在公立醫院及門診診所，為有覆診或已入院的合資格病人接種，包括六個月至未滿18歲及50歲或以上人士、孕婦、合資格的智障或傷殘人士、18至49歲長期病患者，以及長期住院人士。18歲或以上人士接種前應先以醫健通登記。
衞生防護中心指，本港自6月底進入流感季節以來活躍程度仍處高水平，接種後約需兩星期才產生足夠抗體。政府今年新增電子同意書功能，市民由9月17日起可經醫健通流動應用程式提交同意書，再到參與資助計劃的私營診所接種。參與學校外展計劃的家長則由8月17日起已可經同一應用程式為子女提交同意書。
